Hi Liam — thanks for the packet and for the call earlier. Quick checklist from Procurement / AP to close out vendor master creation: 

1) Confirm legal name exactly as it should appear on the vendor master (you listed BlueCascade Solutions, Inc.). If there is a short name or alternate remit name, tell us which to use on POs versus payments.
2) We need a bank verification artifact for ACH (one of: ACH micro-deposit confirmation, voided check, or bank letter). The "BlueCascade_Bank_Details.pdf" you sent looks like routing/account numbers — could you provide a bank letter or the voided check to match?
3) State of incorporation and registered agent (for compliance records).
4) Preferred invoice delivery method (email to ap@bluecascade.com, vendor portal upload, EDI).
5) If you would like early-pay or special net terms, list the account owner to route the request to Sales/Finance.

Template: please drop your preferred invoice header in the attached CSV template (entity_contact_sheet.csv) and send back with the bank artifact.

Once we have the bank verification and the completed contact sheet, AP will provision the remit routing and we will create the vendor ID (expected turnaround 2 business days). We'll then issue test PO 1001 to the ordering contact and confirm acceptance.

If you can send the voided check or bank letter today, I can try to expedite.

Best,
